games.name: Clash of Clans
games.gameplay: Build your dream village, train armies, steal loot from strangers, and blame traps when attacks fail. Strategy + patience = victory.

games.name: Clash Royale
games.gameplay: Fast-paced 1v1 and 2v2 battles where one wrong card drop can ruin your entire match (and mood). Skill matters more than luck.

faqs.question: Which game is better for quick fun?
faqs.answer: Clash Royale wins easily with fast 2–3 minute matches.

faqs.question: Which game rewards long-term dedication?
faqs.answer: Clash of Clans is perfect for players who enjoy slow but meaningful progression.

faqs.question: Are both games pay-to-win?
faqs.answer: No. Spending speeds things up, but skill and strategy still matter most.

faqs.question: Which game is more stressful?
faqs.answer: Clash Royale—because losing in real-time hurts more than failed raids.
